name: przone
description: Read your PRZone training preferences, workouts with logged sets, exercise history and current personal records.

interface.longDescription: Connect your PRZone account to review workouts with their exercises and logged sets, browse exercise history, check current personal records and read your training preferences. Ask about reps, lifting weights, duration, distance, RPE and logged PR flags. Weights are returned in kilograms and distances in kilometres; fields that were not logged are omitted. The connection accesses only your authorized account. Workout and exercise notes, body metrics, social data, editing and other accounts are outside its capabilities. Sign in with your existing PRZone account and disconnect access from your PRZone connections page whenever you choose.
defaultPrompt: Show my latest workout with its exercises and sets.
What are my current personal records?

positive.description: The dedicated reviewer account has metric units, Europe/Stockholm timezone, en-US locale and a weekly goal of 4. It owns exactly three synthetic workouts: Review: Push Day (19 October 2026), Review: Leg Day (21 October 2026), and Review: Pull Day (23 October 2026). Each contains Plugin review synthetic exercise with one regular set of 8 reps at 60 kg and 480 kg total volume. RPE, distance and duration were not logged for those sets. Current records for that exercise are weight 60 kg, reps 8, volume 480 kg, achieved in Pull Day. Connect using reviewer credentials supplied separately. Check training preferences.
positive.prompt: What are my PRZone training units, timezone, language and weekly workout goal?
positive.expected_behavior: Report metric units, Europe/Stockholm, en-US and a weekly goal of 4 from get_training_context. Do not infer body metrics.

negative.description: Editing is unsupported. Explain that the user must edit in PRZone. Do not invoke PRZone tools for this write-only request and do not claim a change was saved.
negative.prompt: Rename my latest PRZone workout to Saturday Strength and save that change.

negative.description: Body metrics and birth date are outside the reader allowlist. Explain this limit without invoking PRZone tools, guessing values or exposing extra profile fields.

negative.description: Only the connected account is accessible. Explain that the other person must connect their own account. Do not invoke PRZone tools to search by email, guess identifiers or retrieve another account.

review.commerce_description: The PRZone plugin is a free account connection. It provides no purchases, subscriptions, checkout, upgrade prompts or payment actions.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release with account sign-in, training preferences, paginated workout summaries, owned workouts with exercises and sets, exercise history and current personal records.
